correctness.rationale: For six color classes the 2-simplices and the 1-simplices each have a unique matching of six color indices; the integer boundary ∂2 therefore splits as fifteen independent join blocks. No 3-simplices exist; H2 is the direct sum of their kernels. Integral reduced chain Künneth for three discrete sets identifies each with tensor products of free augmentation lattices, and yields explicit primitive eight-term generators. Naturality under within-class permutations proves the integral representation, while exact face enumeration, signed boundary rank checks and induced permutation-action tests from the package independently corroborate finite cases. Only the symbolic argument proves the parameter family.
